# defectdojo_development_environment (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a DefectDojo development environment by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_development_environment" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

data "defectdojo_development_environment" "by_id" {
  id = 8
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the development environment to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The name of the development environment to look up, compared exactly. Names aren't unique in DefectDojo: the lookup fails when several environments have the name. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
